text: How to seduce any girl. Let's make something clear right away. If you think there's a method that will guarantee that you will seduce one particular girl, maybe someone you saw on Instagram, your neighbor who doesn't even know you like her, your classmate or your co-worker, such a method does not exist. But don't be so upset. There's a positive side to that. Imagine you already have a girlfriend. And if there were such a method, someone else could just use it and steal her away from you. That wouldn't be so nice, right? When I say you can seduce any girl, it means this. If you have certain criteria and you learn to do everything right on your side, then a girl who fits those criteria will be in your life. So how can you seduce any girl? To explain this, I'll use a business term, the sales funnel. Let's look at seduction funnel. Just like in business, you need a flow of people. In this case, women entering the funnel. That means you have to meet new women online, in real life, parties, hobbies, whatever. Then you invite them up. Some will say no, some will disappear. That's normal. Then you have to have dates where you try to flirt and move things forward. Some dates will be successful, some will fail. Eventually, you'll be able to bring some women home and develop something more serious. At each stage, some part of the women will drop out and this is fine. To sum it up, to seduce any girl, you have to act and follow the seduction funnel. You meet, you ask her out, you have a successful date, you bring her home, you have intimacy. And if you think that this is your person, you build a relationship. It's a difficult process that requires a lot of effort and in which if you want to succeed, you should fail again and again and get through rejection after rejection. But here's the good part. The better you work on yourself, the more vertical your funnel will be. That means that out of the women who enter, a much larger number will be reaching the lower stages of the funnel. Kisses, intimacy, relationships. That's what is meant when it said how to seduce any girl.
